issue.title: Boost.Test 1.65.1, 1.66.0 link problem (Windows)

repository.name: community
repository.description: Central repository for issues and recipes

issue.body:
Consider the following test example:
`conanfile.txt`
```
[requires]
Boost.Test/1.65.1@bincrafters/stable

[generators]
cmake
```
`CMakeLists.txt`
```
project(test CXX)
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)

include(${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/conanbuildinfo.cmake)
conan_basic_setup(TARGETS)

add_executable(main main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(main CONAN_PKG::Boost.Test)
```
`main.cpp`
```
#define BOOST_TEST_MODULE Test
#include <boost/test/unit_test.hpp>
```
Trying to build it:
```
mkdir build
cd build
conan install ..
cmake .. -G "Visual Studio 15 Win64"
cmake --build . --config Release
```
The last command fails with:
```
Link:
  C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2017\Professional\VC\Tools\MSVC\14.12.25827\bin\HostX86\x64\link.exe /ERRORREPORT:QUEUE /O
  UT:"C:\Users\dbely\conan\test-boost\build\bin\main.exe" /INCREMENTAL:NO /NOLOGO C:\.conan\lrp4h4by\1\lib\libboost_prg_exec_monitor.lib C:
  \.conan\lrp4h4by\1\lib\libboost_test_exec_monitor.lib C:\.conan\lrp4h4by\1\lib\libboost_unit_test_framework.lib C:\.conan\678o_6yu\1\lib\
  libboost_container.lib C:\.conan\vlo9eck0\1\lib\libboost_exception.lib C:\.conan\kwmtgrd6\1\lib\libboost_regex.lib C:\.conan\xhm4dv19\1\l
  ib\libboost_timer.lib C:\.conan\9u6x411z\1\lib\libboost_chrono.lib C:\.conan\h46afy7v\1\lib\libboost_system.lib kernel32.lib user32.lib g
  di32.lib winspool.lib shell32.lib ole32.lib oleaut32.lib uuid.lib comdlg32.lib advapi32.lib /MANIFEST /MANIFESTUAC:"level='asInvoker' uiA
  ccess='false'" /manifest:embed /PDB:"C:/Users/dbely/conan/test-boost/build/bin/main.pdb" /SUBSYSTEM:CONSOLE /TLBID:1 /DYNAMICBASE /NXCOMP
  AT /IMPLIB:"C:/Users/dbely/conan/test-boost/build/lib/main.lib" /MACHINE:X64  /machine:x64 main.dir\Release\main.obj
libboost_prg_exec_monitor.lib(cpp_main.obj) : error LNK2019: unresolved external symbol "int __cdecl cpp_main(int,char * * const)" (?cpp_ma in@@YAHHQEAPEAD@Z) referenced in function main [C:\Users\dbely\conan\test-boost\build\main.vcxproj]
C:\Users\dbely\conan\test-boost\build\bin\main.exe : fatal error LNK1120: 1 unresolved externals [C:\Users\dbely\conan\test-boost\build\mai n.vcxproj]
```
If I edit .vcxproj file to remove `libboost_prg_exec_monitor.lib` from link libraries, or reorder them to make `libboost_test_exec_monitor.lib` coming first, it links OK.

issue.body:
Compiler : VC2017 v15
Branch : master
Boost : 1.68
Triplet : x64-windows

Hi vcpkg developers,

I just recently moved to vcpkg and it works great on Linux - thanks for a fantastic tool. However, I'm having some trouble compiling on Windows. I get quite a few link errors of this ilk:

```
[00:06:57] boost_unit_test_framework-vc140-mt.lib(boost_unit_test_framework-vc141-mt-x64-1_68.dll) : error LNK2005: "public: void __cdecl boost::unit_test::unit_test_log_t::set_checkpoint(class boost::unit_test::basic_cstring<char const >,unsigned __int64,class boost::unit_test::basic_cstring<char const >)" (?set_checkpoint@unit_test_log_t@unit_test@boost@@QEAAXV?$basic_cstring@$$CBD@23@_K0@Z) already defined in main.obj [C:\projects\dogen\build\output\msvc\Release\projects\dogen.annotations\tests\annotations.tests.vcxproj]
[00:06:57] boost_unit_test_framework-vc140-mt.lib(boost_unit_test_framework-vc141-mt-x64-1_68.dll) : error LNK2005: "public: __cdecl boost::test_tools::assertion_result::~assertion_result(void)" (??1assertion_result@test_tools@boost@@QEAA@XZ) already defined in main.obj [C:\projects\dogen\build\output\msvc\Release\projects\dogen.annotations\tests\annotations.tests.vcxproj]
[00:06:57] boost_unit_test_framework-vc140-mt.lib(boost_unit_test_framework-vc141-mt-x64-1_68.dll) : error LNK2005: "bool __cdecl boost::test_tools::tt_detail::report_assertion(class boost::test_tools::assertion_result const &,class boost::unit_test::lazy_ostream const &,class boost::unit_test::basic_cstring<char const >,unsigned __int64,enum boost::test_tools::tt_detail::tool_level,enum boost::test_tools::tt_detail::check_type,unsigned __int64,...)" (?report_assertion@tt_detail@test_tools@boost@@YA_NAEBVassertion_result@23@AEBVlazy_ostream@unit_test@3@V?$basic_cstring@$$CBD@63@_KW4tool_level@123@W4check_type@123@3ZZ) already defined in main.obj [C:\projects\dogen\build\output\msvc\Release\projects\dogen.annotations\tests\annotations.tests.vcxproj]
```

All link errors appear to be with Boost.Test. I had a browse at previous issues and it seems remarkably similar to #2444, which has been fixed. In order to ensure there haven't been any regressions, I checked to make sure that ```boost_test_exec_monitor``` was on the ```manual_link``` directory - which it is. So whilst the symptoms are very similar, I'm not sure its the same problem. The other very weird thing I've noticed is that since I moved to vcpkg, CMake seems to be duplicating the link libraries:

```

```

Its not very obvious on that link command but all boost libraries appear twice on the link command, whereas other libraries such as ```libxml``` and ```zlib``` only appear once:

```
 sed -E -e 's/[[:blank:]]+/\n/g' | sort | grep -i third_party | uniq -c
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_atomic-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_chrono-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_date_time-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_filesystem-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_log_setup-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_log-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_program_options-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_regex-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_serialization-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_system-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_thread-vc140-mt.lib"
      2 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\boost_unit_test_framework-vc140-mt.lib"
      1 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\libxml2.lib"
      1 "C:\third_party\installs\vcpkg-export\installed\x64-windows\lib\zlib.lib"
```

This is happening even though according to CMake documentation de-duplication should have kicked in [1], [2]. Interestingly, the linker only complains about Boost.Test and not of any of the other duplicate libraries, so it may be a red herring. The really weird thing is that I was using the exact same version of CMake and Visual Studio prior to upgrading to vcpkg and the link line looks fine (only one entry for the boost libraries). Using vcpkg (and no other changes that I can see) somehow seems to bring in the duplication. I must be missing something obvious as I cannot see how this could be possible :-)

I'll continue to investigate this issue but if anyone has any pointers they would be greatly appreciated.

Cheers

Marco 

[1] http://cmake.3232098.n2.nabble.com/Problem-with-library-link-order-td7589524.html
